title: Start-up of Poiseuille flow (transient, analytic)
description:
A liquid at rest in a periodic channel between two fixed walls is set moving at t = 0 by a constant body force G along x (transient laminar flow, time-dependent study).
Analytic (Fourier series): u(y, t) = G y (H - y) / (2 mu) - (4 G H^2 / (mu pi^3)) sum_odd n sin(n pi y / H) exp(-n^2 t / tau_v) / n^3, tau_v = H^2 / (pi^2 nu); at the centre u_c(t) = (G H^2 / (8 mu)) [1 - (32/pi^3) sum_odd n (-1)^((n-1)/2) exp(-n^2 t / tau_v) / n^3].
Probes tab: centre probe u_x(t) with the dashed series u_centre_exact (5 terms) and the steady value u_steady.
Line profile tab: u_profile_tau (snapshot 1, t = tau_v: the partly developed profile) and u_profile_end (final state, t_end = 5 tau_v).
Derived values tab: u_c_tau (at t = tau_v) and u_c_end (last sample) against the series.
Expected agreement: well below 0.5 % of the steady centre speed, the line profiles relative to their range (lattice diffusion of the lowest mode ~(pi dx / H)^2 / 12 = 2e-3 of its decay rate, the snapshot time within half a lattice step). u_c_end and u_profile_end are toleranced at 0.2 %, below the ~0.7 % transient left at 5 tau_v, so the steady answer fails them.

parameters.name: mu_f
parameters.description: dynamic viscosity of the liquid in Pa s

parameters.name: H_ch
parameters.description: channel height (odd cell count: the centreline is a cell centre)

parameters.name: L_ch
parameters.description: length of the periodic cell along x

parameters.name: G_drive
parameters.description: body force density along x in N/m^3 switched on at t = 0

parameters.name: tau_v
parameters.description: decay time of the slowest viscous mode in s (~4.5e-5)

parameters.name: t_end
parameters.description: study duration in s (the centre speed is then within 0.7 % of steady)

parameters.name: u_c_tau_ref
parameters.description: analytic centre speed at t = tau_v in m/s

parameters.name: u_c_end_ref
parameters.description: analytic centre speed at t_end in m/s
